verses: Truly, my soul waits for God; my salvation comes from him.
He alone is my rock and my salvation; he is my defense; I will not be greatly shaken.
How long will you plot evil against a person? You will all be slain, like a leaning wall and a trembling fence.
They only conspire to bring him down from his high position; they delight in lies; they bless with their mouths but curse inwardly. Selah.
My soul, wait only on God; for my hope is in him.
He alone is my rock and my salvation; he is my defense; I will not be shaken.
In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength and my refuge is in God.
Trust in him at all times; people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.
Surely men of low rank are vanity, and men of high rank are a lie; when weighed, they are altogether lighter than vanity.
Do not trust in oppression, and do not be vain in robbery: if riches increase, do not set your heart on them.
God has spoken once; I have heard it twice: that power belongs to God.
Also to you, O Lord, belongs mercy, for you render to each person according to their deeds.
